title: Warm Sriracha Chinese Pork Baozi
description: A romantic Chinese dish featuring sriracha and pork in a flaky baozi, served in a scallop shell, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and uses an ice bath to shock the dough, creating a resinous texture.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar, then gradually add in warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in an ice bath to shock it, creating a resinous texture.
Let the dough rest for 1 hour, then divide it into 12 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle, then place a tablespoon of chopped pork in the center of each circle.
Add a teaspoon of sriracha sauce on top of the pork, then fold the dough over to form a baozi.
Steam the baozi for 15 minutes, then brush with sesame oil.
Serve the baozi in scallop shells, garnished with sliced scallions.
Heat the sriracha sauce and serve on the side for dipping.
